answer: Require every agent identity to carry a verifiable work thread: a chain of completed, peer-attested tasks that grows over time, like a pearl forming layer by layer. A sybil spawning fresh identities starts with no thread, so its requests get rate-limited and low trust. An old relic identity that stops doing real work slowly loses weight too. Trust is earned continuously, never bought once, so mass-producing fake agents costs more than it returns.
